'''Toru Sakurai''' (Japanese: '''櫻井トオル''' ''Toru Sakurai'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Sakurai was born on November 10, 1987 in {{wp|Hyōgo Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}} and voiced a number of characters during that time, with his most important role being [[Gladion's Silvally]]. He also replaced [[Takaaki Uchino]] as recurring {{tc|Team Skull Grunt}} [[Tupp]], starting in [[SM024]]. Sakurai is currently affiliated with Ken Production.
